text: Smart contracts undermine the parties' ability to continue collaborating when unanticipated eventualities arise, because in most cases of unfulfilled parameters the contract will simply cancel out rather than allow partial performance.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralization - A Primer on the New Economy (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3406323

isBasedOn.name: Decentralization - A Primer on the New Economy

abstract: Smart contracts also undermine counterparties' ability to continue collaboration when unanticipated eventualities arise. In most cases of unfulfilled parameters, the smart contract will simply cancel out.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: contracts where parties may fulfill only a portion of an intended collaboration
